source_text.body:
Monitor chat threads and deliver regular discussion analysis
The poster used Muse to watch chat threads and give regular analysis of what was discussed, but it stopped the task after a safety flag.
·
Nov 6, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The poster had Muse monitor busy group chats about peptides and send regular analyses of what people were discussing. According to the post and follow-up, Muse was reading those chats on an ongoing basis until it hit something that triggered a flag and then refused to keep watching or summarizing them; the person’s role was mainly setting up the watch-and-summary task and checking on the failure afterward.
How it went
It worked well enough to keep up with high-volume chats for a while, but then stopped completely once the content crossed a safety threshold. No performance numbers or time savings were given, and the poster could not recover the workflow from inside the flagged chat.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that long-running monitoring can fail suddenly if the watched discussion includes sensitive or possibly illegal content.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Watch these chat threads: [list of threads or channels] and every [day or week] send me a short analysis of the main topics, open questions, decisions and any action items for me. Only read threads I have explicitly given you access to, and never post or reply on my behalf. If a thread is flagged as sensitive, skip it and tell me instead of stopping the whole task.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseAgent/comments/1xppmyh/muse_flagged_me
